authorization:
사용자 원문: 그래 한 50개 만들고 전부 통과시켜
신규50종의 기술/독립 시각 검수 통과를 위해 지적 좌표를 실제로 교정하고, 이후 사용자 위임으로 Allow한다. 검수 결과를 꾸미지 않고 기존 판정을 보존한다.

issues.message: The colored crown spans approximately x=9..71 here versus x=9..87 in idle_a, while retaining nearly the same height. Together with the narrowed torso this reads as a smaller version of the monster. Redraw the canopy clusters to retain the idle crown mass, showing recoil through tilt and displaced branch tips rather than this abrupt narrowing.

The broad split trunk contracts into a narrow waist strip, and its large dark bark cavity loses much of its width. Keep the established trunk thickness and corresponding light/shadow bark planes through the recoil bend; move those connected planes with the body so the king does not appear to lose wood between recover and hit.

In both sleep_a and sleep_b the left trunk face becomes a smooth tall orange slab with a thin straight highlight, losing the recognizable split-bark clusters seen in idle. Restore the large bark cleft and a few matching angular bark ridges on this face while keeping the closed eyes and bent root legs. Carry those same clusters into sleep_b so the breathing pair retains the pine king material.
